title: Lanterns by the Footbridge
caption: Instrumental original GBA JRPG town cue in D major at 112 BPM. Preserve the supplied complete 24-bar score, its original Promise-of-the-Lantern motif, consonant major/minor triads and independent bass. Clear trumpet melody, clarinet contrast, restrained piano and compact percussion. No reharmonization, nonchord additions, harsh transients, vocals or fade.
form_description: 24 bars: an eight-bar local statement; eight-bar contrasting register and timbre; eight-bar developed return.
composition_notes: Original triadic melodic writing: no nonchord passing/neighbor tones against full accompaniment. Three harmony voices move as close as feasible without parallel perfect fifths/octaves; harmonic-minor dominant leading tones resolve upward at V–i cadences. Independently scored bass avoids parallel perfect fifths/octaves against the exposed melody, including the loop return. Chord doublings are ensemble orchestration rather than independent species counterpoint. The small original leitmotif returns in scene-specific rhythm, mode, register or contour, following recurring-theme game-score practice.

harmonic_policy.scalar_melody_policy: Thinned support at nonchord melodic notes; independently scored bass, no fixed-root pedal that clashes with passing tones
harmonic_policy.bass_voice: Independent movement with exposed parallel fifth/octave avoidance
harmonic_policy.release_policy: Per-part release gates before unsafe pitch/harmony transitions; no old support tail may create an unintended clash

voice_leading.parallel_perfect_policy: No same-direction parallel octaves or fifths in exposed melody/bass and three ordered harmony voices; loop transition included
voice_leading.chord_voice_leading: Constrained nearest motion; V leading tone resolves upward to tonic
voice_leading.counterpoint_scope: Independent melody and bass; no claim that all ensemble doublings implement strict species counterpoint

leitmotif.description_ja: この曲が独自主題「灯火の約束」の基準です。8小節の呼びかけ、8小節の静かな応答、8小節の帰還。

identity_description_ja: 主題「灯火の約束」の本来の姿。非対称の呼びかけと返答、タイトルのトランペットと静かなクラリネット。
